effect_description_eng:
＜Use Req. ([SW] trait)＞ (Specified cards let you ignore color requirements.)
[Main] By trashing 1 [SW] trait card from your hand, ＜Draw 2＞ (Draw 2 cards from your deck.) After, place this card in the battle area.
[All Turns] When any of your [SW] trait Digimon are played, ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect below.)
・1 of your [SW] trait Digimon may digivolve into a [Saneiketsu] trait Digimon card in the hand without paying the cost.
